T: You were the chosen one. To bring dessert.
D: As the Clone Wars end, Anakin is pulled to the dark side and the Jedi fall.
P: Serve dessert when the duel on Mustafar begins.
S: the Wookiee home world of Kashyyyk
Mixed mushrooms sautéed in butter with garlic and thyme, piled onto toasted sourdough and finished with shaved parmesan.
Mini vol-au-vent cases filled with creamy chicken and leek, baked at 200C for 10 minutes until golden.
Galaxies Opera House smoked salmon blinis
Palpatine and Anakin at the opera

Warm blinis topped with smoked salmon, lemony crème fraîche, salmon roe and chives, served on a dark tray like the box at the opera. Warm 16 blinis at 160C for 5 minutes. Mix 150g crème fraîche with the zest of a lemon, salt and pepper. Top each blini with a spoon of the crème fraîche and a fold of smoked salmon from 200g. Finish with a small spoon of salmon roe and snipped chives. Serve straight away on a dark tray.
M: Senate chamber beef fillet, red wine jus
the halls of power on Coruscant

Eye fillet roasted to medium rare and sliced, with a glossy red wine jus, a crunchy-topped potato gratin and honey roasted carrots. Layer 1kg thinly sliced potatoes with 300ml cream, garlic and salt and bake at 180C for 1 hour, adding 40g grated parmesan for the last 15 minutes. Roast 500g carrots with oil and honey. Sear a 1kg eye fillet on all sides, then roast at 220C to 54C inside, about 20 minutes, and rest. Reduce 200ml red wine with 300ml beef stock and thyme to a glossy jus and whisk in 20g butter.

Whole duck rubbed with salt and five-spice and roasted until the skin crackles, glazed with orange, honey, soy and star anise, sliced over jasmine rice. Prick a 2kg duck all over, rub with salt and 1 tsp five spice and roast on a rack at 180C for 1 hour 45 minutes. Simmer the juice of 2 oranges, 3 tbsp honey, 2 tbsp soy and 2 star anise until syrupy. Brush the glaze over the duck for the last 15 minutes. Rest 10 minutes, carve and serve over 300g steamed jasmine rice with the rest of the glaze.
W: Dark chocolate fondants baked at 200C for 10 minutes so the middle stays molten, turned out with raspberry coulis running out like lava.
K: baby Luke handed over under the twin suns
Orange and pineapple juice over ice with grenadine poured in last to sink like a sunset.

s.note: the Wookiee home world of Kashyyyk
s.how: Slice 500g mixed mushrooms and fry in butter over high heat until golden. Add crushed garlic and thyme and cook another minute. Toast thick slices of sourdough, pile the mushrooms on top and finish with shaved parmesan and a crack of pepper.

Soften a sliced leek in butter, add 300g finely diced chicken breast and cook through. Stir in 150ml cream and chopped tarragon and simmer until thick. Spoon into 16 vol-au-vent cases and bake at 200C for 10 minutes until golden and hot.

m.how: Prick a 2kg duck all over, rub with salt and 1 tsp five spice and roast on a rack at 180C for 1 hour 45 minutes. Simmer the juice of 2 oranges, 3 tbsp honey, 2 tbsp soy and 2 star anise until syrupy. Brush the glaze over the duck for the last 15 minutes. Rest 10 minutes, carve and serve over 300g steamed jasmine rice with the rest of the glaze.

w.how: Melt 150g dark chocolate with 150g butter. Whisk 3 eggs and 3 yolks with 80g sugar until thick, fold in the chocolate and 50g flour. Pour into greased moulds and bake at 200C for 10 minutes. Turn out and pour over a coulis of blended raspberries.

d.note: baby Luke handed over under the twin suns
d.how: Fill tall glasses with ice. Pour in equal parts orange juice and pineapple juice, leaving room at the top. Slowly pour a splash of grenadine down the side so it sinks to the bottom and glows red and orange like a double sunset.
